tower_identity: BQ Workmen Housing Typical Residential Tower (Block A-H)

structural_configuration.foundation: 207 bored cast-in-situ RCC piles (600mm dia direct; 18m length assumed from DBR range 15-20m, tabulated schedule not found) + pile caps (unresolved 54 vs 84 contradiction) + plinth beams
structural_configuration.framing: Special Moment Resisting Frame (SMRF) with ductile RC shear walls (IS 13920:2016)
structural_configuration.concrete_grade: M30 for all RCC; M10 for lean concrete (PCC)
structural_configuration.shear_walls: 33 ductile shear wall elements (SW1-SW5: 230mm thk, SW6-SW10: 230mm core wall)
structural_configuration.slabs: 125mm two-way cast-in-situ RCC floor and roof slabs
structural_configuration.stairs: Doglegged RCC staircase, 150mm waist slab, 150mm riser, 300mm tread, 1.50m flight width

architectural_configuration.external_walls: 230mm brick masonry in CM 1:6 with 18mm waterproof plaster
architectural_configuration.internal_walls: 115mm brick masonry in CM 1:4 with 12mm cement plaster
architectural_configuration.flooring: Vitrified tiles (600x600) in living/bed, anti-skid ceramic in toilets/balconies, Kota stone in stairs, VDF in stilt
